info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Airline Flights Refunds-v2-spec
info.description: The Airline Flights Refunds API provides a streamlined way for users to access information regarding refunds for airline flights. This endpoint allows consumers to retrieve detailed listings of flight refunds, supporting various use cases such as customer service inquiries, financial reconciliations, and data analysis. Typically utilized by travel agencies, airline customer support teams, and financial analysts, this API enhances transparency and facilitates effective refund management. It serves as an essential resource for businesses seeking to improve customer experiences and operational efficiencies related to flight refunds.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information regarding the refund process for a specific flight. It provides insights into eligibility, time frames, and any necessary documentation required for processing the refund.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a refund process for a flight. Ensure that the appropriate parameters are provided in the JSON format to successfully execute a refund request.

202.description: The request has been accepted and is being processed.

ListAirlineFlightsRefundsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body expected for refund operations related to flights.

status.description: Indicates if the refund process was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the refund request.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the refund process.

state.description: The current state of the refund request.

processingTimeMs.description: The processing time for the refund request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the refund request.

audit.description: Audit information related to the refund request.

ListAirlineFlightsRefundsResponse_202.description: Response schema for refund operations indicating the status and details of the refund request.

createdBy.description: The username or identifier of the user who created the refund request.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the refund request was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the refund request was created automatically.
